zh: 时间线
可选简洁、标准或详细。默认是标准。提问和计划在三种模式下都保留。
简洁：只保留对话和结果。
标准：还会保留文件改动、失败步骤、子任务，以及新建或发消息给 Agent。
详细：显示每一步，包括思考。
任务面板
工作区很多时，任务留在原泳道，不再被移入已归档。
未读任务留在待查看，不会因列表较长而消失。
刷新、重连或读取失败时，看板已有卡片会保留。断开的列表会重新连上。
已移除的任务不会再出现，过期的失败也不会显示为错误。
归档时，卡片不再闪过已完成。
插件有更新时，主机的插件列表也会提示。
其他细节优化。
en: Timeline
Choose Simple, Standard, or Detailed. Standard is the default. Questions and plans stay in all three.
Simple: keeps only conversation and results.
Standard: also keeps file changes, failed steps, subtasks, and creating or messaging an agent.
Detailed: shows every step, including reasoning.
Task panel
When there are many workspaces, tasks stay in their lanes and are no longer moved to archived.
Unread tasks stay in review and do not disappear when the list is long.
A refresh, reconnect, or failed read keeps existing cards on the board. A dropped list reconnects.
A removed task does not reappear, and an outdated failure is not shown as an error.
Archiving no longer flashes the card through done.
When a plugin update is available, the host plugin list shows it too.
Other detail refinements.
